name: Kashima (Saga, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kashima city emblem in pink: a stylised device of curved petals, like a bud.
history: Municipal flag of Kashima, a city in Saga Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 August 1954.

features.role: Kashima city emblem — a stylised device of curved petals, like a bud
